collate_batch: collate a batch of tensors, numpy arrays, dicts, or namedtuples into stacked tensors for PyTorch DataLoader
set_num_threads: set the number of threads for numpy, MKL, OpenBLAS, and PyTorch to limit CPU usage
worker_init_fn: initialize a DataLoader worker with seeded randomness and configurable thread limits from dataset config
unbatch_to_device: move batched data to a device, squeeze batch dimension from tensors, and unwrap single-item string lists
review_collate_function: review the collate function to understand how it handles tensors, numpy arrays, dicts, and namedtuples
